testId.description: Stable test identifier from the test plan (e.g. CORE-05, ID-04, DPNS-05). Unique per testCase.

title.description: Human-readable action being tested (the plan's Action column).

tier.description: Frequency tier. One of: Essential, Common, Thorough, Uncommon, Manual (Unspecified for stub rows).

category.description: Feature area / Domain (e.g. Core, Identity, DPNS, Token, Shielded, MultiWallet).

layer.description: Stack layer. One of: Core, Platform, Cross, Shielded.

implStatus.description: Implementation status glyph mirrored from the plan (✅ implemented, 🧪 builder-only, ⚠️ partial/mock, 🔌 FFI-only, 🚫 not implemented).

description.description: Entry point & test notes for the action (the plan's last column).

entryPoint.description: Primary code entry point (view / FFI function) that drives the action.

prerequisites.description: Fixtures/preconditions required before this test can run.

planCommit.description: git commit (short or full SHA) of TEST_PLAN.md this testCase was seeded from.

testCase.description: A single test definition, mirroring one row of the iOS TEST_PLAN §4 catalog. Mutable so implementation status / entry points can be updated as the plan evolves; owner-only creation (v1 single QA identity).

testId.description: Test identifier this run is a result for (matches testCase.testId).

result.description: Outcome. One of: pass, fail, blocked, skipped.

network.description: Network the run executed against (e.g. testnet, devnet).

buildRef.description: Build under test (commit SHA, branch+sha, or app build number).

device.description: Device / simulator the run executed on (e.g. iPhone 16 Simulator, iOS 18.2).

evidence.description: Pointer to evidence (txid, on-chain id, screenshot path, or URL).

blockerReason.description: Why the run was blocked/skipped (precondition unmet, environment limit, etc.).

testRun.description: An append-only record of one test execution. Immutable and non-deletable: it is an audit log. $createdAt is the run time. Owner-only creation in v1 (single QA identity); relax creationRestrictionMode to 0 to let any identity submit runs.
